# `community` — `/api/community`

Arynwood Community (Arynwood Grove) — the Community page's connection to a Grove.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| PUT | [`/api/community/address`](#put-api-community-address) | Choose the Grove (an empty address returns to the default). |
| GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE | [`/api/community/grove/{path}`](#get-api-community-grove-path) | A Community-page request passed to the Grove's own API at /api/{path} (only the areas in GROVE_AREAS), with the Grove sign-in this backend holds. |
| WS | [`/api/community/grove/{path}`](#ws-api-community-grove-path) | The Grove host's IRC connection (its host account only) and Public chat (any member, when the Grove has a room). |
| POST | [`/api/community/open`](#post-api-community-open) | Open the Grove (target=app) or its source repo (target=repo) in the system browser — the desktop app's web view can't open external windows, and a Grove refuses framing. |
| GET | [`/api/community/preview/{token}/{path}`](#get-api-community-preview-token-path) | A Grove website preview, at the address the Grove gives it: `/api/community/preview/<signed>/…` is this router's prefix too, so the addresses the Grove rewrote inside the pages lead back here. |
| POST | [`/api/community/start`](#post-api-community-start) | Start the Grove installed on this computer (Linux only). |
| GET | [`/api/community/status`](#get-api-community-status) | The Grove the Community page uses: its address, whether it is on this computer, its state (running, starting, stopped, failed or unreachable) and what can be done from here. |
| POST | [`/api/community/stop`](#post-api-community-stop) | Stop the Grove on this computer, only if Arynwood started it. |

<a id="put-api-community-address"></a>
### `PUT /api/community/address`

Choose the Grove (an empty address returns to the default). Changing it forgets the sign-in, which belonged to the previous Grove.

- Handler: [`set_address`](../../../backend/routers/community.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `AddressBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `label`, `mode`, `url`, `default_url`, `status`, `version`, `dir`, `repo_url`, `installed`, `setup_missing`, `managed`, `can_start`, `can_stop`, `error`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | the underlying error's message | `set_address` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-community-grove-path"></a>
<a id="post-api-community-grove-path"></a>
<a id="put-api-community-grove-path"></a>
<a id="patch-api-community-grove-path"></a>
<a id="delete-api-community-grove-path"></a>
### `GET POST PUT PATCH DELETE /api/community/grove/{path}`

A Community-page request passed to the Grove's own API at /api/{path} (only the areas in GROVE_AREAS), with the Grove sign-in this backend holds. The Grove's status code and answer come back as it sent them; a path ending in /events is relayed as a server-sent event stream. The Grove documents its API in its own repository.

- Handler: [`grove_passthrough`](../../../backend/routers/community.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a raw body, with the upstream's type, or streamed `application/octet-stream` body
- `200`: a raw body, with the upstream's type, or streamed `text/event-stream` body

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | That isn't part of the Community page. | `_grove_path` |
| 413 | That's too large to send to the Grove. | `_read_body` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Couldn't reach the Grove at {_host(url)}. Check that it's running, or change the Grove address on the Community page. | `_unreachable` |
| 502 | The Grove at {_host(url)} sent Arynwood elsewhere{where}. If it moved, enter its new address on the Community page. | `_moved` |
| 502 | The Grove's answer was too large. | `_answer` |
| 504 | The Grove at {_host(url)} didn't answer in time. | `_unreachable` |

<a id="ws-api-community-grove-path"></a>
### `WS /api/community/grove/{path}`

The Grove host's IRC connection (its host account only) and Public chat (any member, when the Grove has a room). Opens the Grove's socket first, so a refusal there refuses this one.

- Handler: [`grove_socket`](../../../backend/routers/community.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- WebSocket. Protocol: [Grove relay](../README.md#grove-relay-apicommunitygrove).

<a id="post-api-community-open"></a>
### `POST /api/community/open`

Open the Grove (target=app) or its source repo (target=repo) in the system browser — the desktop app's web view can't open external windows, and a Grove refuses framing.

- Handler: [`open_in_browser`](../../../backend/routers/community.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | query | string | no | `"app"` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `url`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | target must be 'app' or 'repo' | `open_in_browser` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 501 | Couldn't open a browser ({e}). Open {url} yourself. | `open_in_browser` |

<a id="get-api-community-preview-token-path"></a>
### `GET /api/community/preview/{token}/{path}`

A Grove website preview, at the address the Grove gives it: `/api/community/preview/<signed>/…` is this router's prefix too, so the addresses the Grove rewrote inside the pages lead back here. The signed address is the whole permission, so no Grove sign-in goes with it, and only this app's own page may frame it. The page itself runs sandboxed, as on the Grove.

- Handler: [`grove_preview`](../../../backend/routers/community.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set; GET/HEAD allowed cross-site (the app's own media and frames); GET/HEAD allowed from `Origin: null` (sandboxed website previews)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `path` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a raw body, with the upstream's type, or streamed `application/octet-stream` body

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | File not found. | `_preview_path` |
| 404 | Preview expired or unavailable. Open it again. | `grove_preview` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Couldn't reach the Grove at {_host(url)}. Check that it's running, or change the Grove address on the Community page. | `_unreachable` |
| 502 | The Grove at {_host(url)} sent Arynwood elsewhere{where}. If it moved, enter its new address on the Community page. | `_moved` |
| 502 | The Grove's answer was too large. | `_answer` |
| 504 | The Grove at {_host(url)} didn't answer in time. | `_unreachable` |

<a id="post-api-community-start"></a>
### `POST /api/community/start`

Start the Grove installed on this computer (Linux only). It keeps running after Arynwood quits.

- Handler: [`start`](../../../backend/routers/community.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `status`
- `200`: JSON object with `status`, `pid`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Community is hosted at {url}; it isn't started from this computer. | `start` |
| 404 | Arynwood Community isn't installed at {display_path(directory)}. Set ARYNWOOD_COMMUNITY_DIR to its folder. | `start` |
| 409 | Community isn't set up yet (missing {', '.join(missing)}). Run ./setup.sh in {display_path(directory)}. | `start` |
| 500 | {f'{LABEL} exited immediately (code {code}). {_failure}'.strip()} | `start` |
| 501 | Community's local launcher requires Linux. Start your Grove separately and enter its address here. | `start` |
